description: This file defines classes and functions for building and manipulating a DOM-like tree structure, including Node, ActiveFormattingElements, and TreeBuilder classes, used for parsing and handling HTML/XML documents.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Represents an element or node in the document tree with methods for manipulation.

classes.name: ActiveFormattingElements
classes.description: A specialized list managing active formatting elements with duplicate removal logic.

classes.name: TreeBuilder
classes.description: A base class for constructing a document tree, managing elements, scope, and insertion logic.

methods.name: appendChild
methods.description: Insert node as a child of the current node (not implemented).

methods.name: insertText
methods.description: Insert text into the current node (not implemented).

methods.name: insertBefore
methods.description: Insert a node before a reference node (not implemented).

methods.name: removeChild
methods.description: Remove a child node (not implemented).

methods.name: cloneNode
methods.description: Return a shallow copy of the node (not implemented).

methods.name: hasContent
methods.description: Check if node has children or text (not implemented).

methods.name: reconstructActiveFormattingElements
methods.description: Rebuilds the list of active formatting elements following the HTML parsing algorithm.

methods.name: clearActiveFormattingElements
methods.description: Clears the list of active formatting elements up to the last marker.

methods.name: elementInScope
methods.description: Checks if an element is in the current scope based on variant.

methods.name: insertRoot
methods.description: Inserts the root element into the document.

methods.name: insertDoctype
methods.description: Creates and inserts a doctype node.

methods.name: insertComment
methods.description: Creates and inserts a comment node.

methods.name: createElement
methods.description: Creates an element node from a token without inserting it.

methods.name: insertElementNormal
methods.description: Creates and inserts an element in normal mode.

methods.name: insertElementTable
methods.description: Creates and inserts an element in table mode, handling misnesting.

methods.name: insertText
methods.description: Inserts text into the current node, handling table misnesting if needed.

methods.name: getTableMisnestedNodePosition
methods.description: Finds the foster parent and insertion point for misnested table nodes.

methods.name: generateImpliedEndTags
methods.description: Closes implied end tags for certain elements.

methods.name: getDocument
methods.description: Returns the constructed document.

methods.name: getFragment
methods.description: Returns a document fragment with reparented children.

methods.name: testSerializer
methods.description: Serializes a node subtree for testing purposes.
